tools.title: Efficient Document Management System
tools.tagline: The first DPDP Act Compliant document management system for CA Firms.
tools.what_it_solves: CA Firms handle hundreds of client documents daily — ITRs, GST filings, audit reports, agreements. These get scattered across WhatsApp, email, local drives, and USB sticks. This system brings all of it into one secure, organized, searchable place — without uploading to third-party cloud platforms.
features: Centralized document storage — no third-party cloud dependency
Client-wise and document-type-wise folder structure
DPDP Act compliant — data stays within your premises
Searchable by client, document type, or date
Access control — team members see only what they need to
Audit trail — who accessed or modified what and when

tools.title: GST Reconciliation Automation
tools.tagline: Reconcile GSTR-2A/2B with your purchase register in minutes, not hours.
tools.what_it_solves: GST reconciliation is one of the most tedious tasks in Finance — matching hundreds of invoices across GSTR-2A/2B and purchase registers, finding mismatches, and tracking differences month after month. This tool automates the entire comparison and generates a clean, actionable report.
features: Upload GSTR-2A/2B and purchase register — reconciliation runs automatically
Identifies matched, unmatched, and partially matched invoices
Highlights discrepancies in GSTIN, invoice number, date, and amount
Exports results to a formatted Excel report
Month-over-month tracking across reconciliation runs
No manual VLOOKUP or pivot tables needed

thumbnail.alt: Interactive Client Portal for CA Firms

tools.title: Client Portal for CA Firms
tools.tagline: A secure, professional space for your clients to share documents and track their work.
tools.what_it_solves: CA Firms spend enormous time chasing clients for documents over WhatsApp and email — a mix of informal channels that are impossible to track and not secure. This portal gives each client a dedicated, secure space to upload documents, check the status of their filings, and communicate with the firm.
features: Each client gets their own secure login
Document upload and download with version history
Work status tracker — clients see where their filing stands
Automated notifications when work is completed or documents are needed
Internal team view to manage all clients from one dashboard
No sensitive documents over WhatsApp or personal email

tools.title: PDF & Excel Automation Toolkit
tools.tagline: Stop manually copying tables from PDFs into Excel.
tools.what_it_solves: Finance teams regularly receive data in PDF format — bank statements, invoices, GST certificates, audit reports. Extracting this data into Excel manually is slow, error-prone, and mind-numbing. This toolkit automates the extraction and formatting.
features: Extract tables from PDFs into Excel with one click
Merge multiple PDFs into a single file
Split a large PDF into individual pages or sections
Extract text, amounts, and dates from invoice PDFs
Batch process entire folders of PDFs
Output as structured Excel with correct column headers

tools.title: GST Automation via Power Query
tools.tagline: For Finance teams who live in Excel — GST reconciliation without writing code.
tools.what_it_solves: Not everyone wants to learn Python. For Finance professionals who are comfortable in Excel, this Power Query-based solution automates GST data processing, reconciliation, and reporting — entirely within Excel, with no coding required.
features: Fully Excel-based — no Python or external tools needed
Load and transform GSTR data with Power Query automatically
One-click refresh to update reports with new data
Dynamic reconciliation tables with automatic mismatch highlighting
Summary dashboards for management reporting
Works with Excel 2016 and above

tools.title: File & Folder Management Utilities
tools.tagline: Stop organizing files manually. Let Python do it.
tools.what_it_solves: Finance teams deal with hundreds of files — monthly reports, client documents, backups, downloads. Manually renaming, sorting, and organizing these is a silent time drain. These utilities automate the entire file management workflow.
features: Auto-organize files into folders by date, client name, or file type
Bulk rename files using a pattern (e.g. ClientName_Month_Year)
Detect and flag duplicate files across folders
Archive old files automatically based on date rules
Watch a folder and trigger actions when new files arrive
Generate a structured file inventory report in Excel
suitable_for: Anyone managing large volumes of files
